title: Gold Star
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Gold
learningObjectives: Explain how a star polygon is drawn by alternating vertices between an outer radius and an inner radius as the angle sweeps around a circle
Calculate the angular step between consecutive vertices as TWO_PI divided by twice the number of points
Predict how moving the points slider from 4 to 20 changes the sharpness of each star point
Identify the roles of the canvas coordinates cx and cy, the radius r, and the sin/cos conversion from polar to Cartesian position
Design a variation of the sketch by changing the inner-to-outer radius ratio and describing the resulting shape
